item.title: 19-Year-Old
item.description: Jammu Police arrested 19-year-old Mohammad Sajid from Bathindi, exposing a dangerous cross-border conspiracy. Investigators say Sajid had been in encrypted online contact with Pakistan-based terror handlers and was being groomed as a "white-collar jihadi" to radicalize local youth and facilitate a possible attack in Jammu.

item.title: NSE Cuts Fin Nifty Quantity Freeze Limit to 1,200 Contracts from Dec 1
item.description: The National Stock Exchange (NSE) has revised the quantity freeze limit for Fin Nifty (NIFTY Financial Services Index derivatives) to 1,200 contracts, effective December 1. A quantity freeze limit restricts the maximum order size a trader can place in a single order, helping prevent erroneous large trades and maintaining orderly market functioning.
